name: mid-career-single
facts:
Goal: maximize wealth at the end of the plan (terminal wealth), planning to age 90.
- Age 40, single filer, retiring at 65.
- Gross income $150,000 a year; can save $30,000 a year.
- Will spend $80,000 a year in retirement.
- Balances: $200,000 traditional (pre-tax), $50,000 Roth, $100,000 taxable brokerage.
- Social Security: $30,000 a year starting at age 67. No pension.
- No employer match; happy with the assistant's default assumptions for everything else.
